# The menu of the unit and type pickers: the headings in order, and under each
# the units in order, one a line. A unit is written as the registry writes it
# (`N.m`, `kg.m^-3`); anything after ` | ` is a note and is not read. A
# quantity type is filed under the heading of its preferred unit.
# Every live unit and every preferred unit must be listed once, which the
# registry checks when it loads. To move a unit, move its line.

== SI Base
m | Length (metre)
kg | Mass (kilogram)
s | Duration (second)
A | Current (ampere)
K | Temperature (kelvin)
mol | AmountOfSubstance (mole)
cd | LuminousIntensity (candela)

== Data
b | Data (bit)
B | Data (byte)
b.s^-1 | DataRate
b.m^-2 | DataDensity
bps | DataRate (bit per second)

== Computing
tok | Tokens
tok.s^-1 | TokenRate
flop | Flops
FLOPS | FlopRate
op | Operations
OPS | OperationRate
IOPS | OperationRate (I/O per second)
px | Pixels

== Angle
rad | Angle (radian)
° | Angle (degree)
′ | Angle (arcminute)
″ | Angle (arcsecond)
gon | Angle (gon)
sr | SolidAngle (steradian)

== Timespan
min | Duration (minute)
h | Duration (hour)
d | Duration (day)
wk | Duration (week)
yr | Duration (year)

== Magnitude
g | Mass (gram)
t | Mass (tonne)
kt | Mass (kilotonne)
Mt | Mass (megatonne)
m^2 | Area
ha | Area (hectare)
m^3 | Volume
l | Volume (litre)

== Length
in | Length (inch)
ft | Length (foot)
yd | Length (yard)
mi | Length (mile)
fur | Length (furlong)
ftm | Length (fathom)
chain | Length (chain)
rod | Length (rod)
thou | Length (thou)

== Mass
oz | Mass (ounce)
lb | Mass (pound)
st | Mass (stone)
cwt | Mass (hundredweight)
ton | Mass (short ton)
lton | Mass (long ton)
gr | Mass (grain)
ozt | Mass (troy ounce)
dwt | Mass (pennyweight)
slug | Mass (slug)

== Area
ft^2 | Area (square foot)
in^2 | Area (square inch)
mi^2 | Area (square mile)
ac | Area (acre)

== Volume
ft^3 | Volume (cubic foot)
in^3 | Volume (cubic inch)
gal | Volume (US gallon)
qt | Volume (US quart)
pt | Volume (US pint)
cup | Volume (US cup)
floz | Volume (US fluid ounce)
tbsp | Volume (tablespoon)
tsp | Volume (teaspoon)
bbl | Volume (barrel)
impgal | Volume (imperial gallon)
imppint | Volume (imperial pint)
cord | Volume (cord)

== Mechanical
Hz | Frequency (hertz)
m.s^-1 | Speed
m.s^-2 | Acceleration
m^3.s^-1 | Flow
N.s | Impulse
kg.m.s^-1 | Momentum
kg.m^2 | MomentOfInertia
rad.s^-1 | AngularSpeed
kg.m^2.s^-1 | AngularMomentum
mph | Speed (mile per hour)
fps | Speed (foot per second)
ft.s^-2 | Acceleration (foot per second squared)

== Physical
Pa | Pressure (pascal)
N | Force (newton)
J | Energy (joule)
W | Power (watt)
N.m | Torque
W.m^-2 | Irradiance
kg.m^-2 | ArealDensity
kg.m^-3 | Density
lbf | Force (pound-force)
ozf | Force (ounce-force)
psi | Pressure (pound per square inch)
btu | Energy (British thermal unit)
therm | Energy (therm)
lbf.ft | Torque (pound-foot)
hp | Power (mechanical horsepower)

== Thermal
°C | Temperature (Celsius)
J.kg^-1 | SpecificEnergy
W.kg^-1 | SpecificPower
J.kg^-1.K^-1 | SpecificHeat
W.K^-1 | ThermalConductance
K.W^-1 | ThermalResistance
°F | Temperature (Fahrenheit)
°R | Temperature (Rankine)

== Electromagnetic
C | Charge (coulomb)
V | Potential (volt)
Ω | Resistance (ohm)
S | Conductance (siemens)
F | Capacitance (farad)
H | Inductance (henry)
T | MagneticField (tesla)
Wb | MagneticFlux (weber)

== Astronomical
au | Length (astronomical unit)
ld | Length (light day)

lm | LuminousFlux (lumen)

== Chemical
Å | Length (angstrom)
Da | Mass (dalton)
cal | Energy (calorie)
kat | CatalyticActivity (katal)

== Radiation
Bq | Radioactivity (becquerel)
Ci | Frequency (curie)
rem | SpecificEnergy (rem)
Gy | Dose (gray)
Sv | SpecificEnergy (sievert)
R | RadiationExposure (roentgen)

== Typographic
pica | Length (pica)
point | Length (point)

== Contextual
nmi | Length (nautical mile)
are | Area (are)

gsm | ArealDensity (gram per square metre)
